Hon'ble Mr. Justice arun dev choudhury 19.10.2023
1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2.  The present application is filed under section 397/401/482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 read with Section 451/457 of the Page No.# 2/3 Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 praying for setting aside and quashing of the impugned order dated 03.10.2023 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Kamrup (M) in connection with Chandmari Police Station Case No. 294/2023 under Sections 120(B)/420/382/356 of IPC, thereby rejecting the zimma of the vehicle to the petitioner bearing registration No. AS-01 QC-4772.

3. The present petitioner filed an application before the learned court below for zimma of the vehicle and during the aforesaid proceeding, the learned court below by its order dated 03.10.2023 rejected Luis Ali vs The State Of Assam on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18095110/
1 the petition filed by the petitioner.

sentences.text:
4. The Hon'ble Apex court in the case of Sunder Bhai Ambala Desai Vs. State of Gujrat reported in (2002) 10 SCC 283 while dealing with the power of a magistrate under section 451 and 457 Cr.P.C.,
regarding disposal of seized material has laid down the following proposition of law:-
I. That the application for zimma of seized material shall be dealt expeditiously and judiciously with the object that the owner of the seized article should not suffer for it being remaining unused or by its misappropriation, II.

entities.text: Sunder Bhai Ambala Desai Vs. State of Gujrat reported in (2002) 10 SCC 283
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The hon'ble apex court at paragraph 17 observed that whatever the situation be, it is of no use to keep the materials more particularly seized vehicles at police station for a long period.

5. In view of the aforesaid settled propositions of law, this court, in the given facts of the present case is of the view that the seized vehicle be released to the registered owner subject to the following conditions:
I. The investigating authority shall prepare proper panchnama Page No.# 3/3 of the vehicle and take photographs of such vehicle and get the signature of the owner or representative of the owner after proper verification and the owner shall give a bond of Rs.8,00,000/-.
II.
The petitioner/owner shall not change the colour or structure of the vehicle and shall not also dispose of the vehicle till disposal of the case.

III. The petitioner/owner shall produce the vehicle before the I/O or concerned authority as and when called for the purpose of investigation or trial.
6.
With the aforesaid the present petition stands allowed.
